# Truth

```{r, fig.width=12}
set.seed(123456)
library(umap)
library(mclust)
umap_plots <- lapply(1:length(list_muS), function(i) {
  umap_results <- umap(t(list_muS[[i]]), n_neighbors = n_rep, random_state=12345)
  embedding <- umap_results$layout
  kmeans_results <- kmeans(embedding, centers = 3, nstart = n_rep)
  embedding_df <- data.frame(embedding, Cluster = factor(kmeans_results$cluster), Type = cell_type_label)
  ari_value <- adjustedRandIndex(kmeans_results$cluster, rep(1:3, each = n_rep))
  plot_title <- names(list_muS)[i]
  plot_subtitle = paste("ARI:",round(ari_value, 3))
  ggplot(embedding_df, aes(x = X1, y = X2, color = Type, shape = Cluster)) +
  geom_point(size = 3) + labs(title = plot_title, subtitle = plot_subtitle) + theme_minimal() + 
    theme(legend.position = "none")
})
library(gridExtra)
do.call("grid.arrange", c(umap_plots, ncol=5))

```

# Simulated Data by Chr

```{r, fig.width=12}
plot_tsne_simY_by_chr_tbl <- function(list_y_sim,
                                      npc       = 20,
                                      pplx      = 7,
                                      n_rep     = 10,
                                      tsne_seed = 12345) {
  # unique chromosomes (numeric)
  chr_ids <- sort(unique(list_y_sim$chr))

  # coverage levels in desired order (from the ordered factor)
  cov_levels <- levels(list_y_sim$coverage)
  if (is.null(cov_levels)) {
    cov_levels <- sort(unique(list_y_sim$coverage))
  }

  for (chr_id in chr_ids) {
    chr_dat <- list_y_sim %>% 
      filter(chr == chr_id)

    if (nrow(chr_dat) == 0) {
      warning("No rows for chr = ", chr_id)
      next
    }

    set.seed(tsne_seed)

    tsne_plots <- lapply(cov_levels, function(cv) {
      # subset row for this chr and coverage
      row_cv <- chr_dat %>% filter(coverage == cv)

      lambda_lab <- as.character(cv)

      # if missing this coverage, show placeholder
      if (nrow(row_cv) == 0) {
        return(
          ggplot() +
            geom_rect(aes(xmin = -10, xmax = 10,
                          ymin = -10, ymax = 10),
                      fill = NA, color = "grey70", linewidth = 0.6) +
            annotate("text",
                     x = 0, y = 0,
                     label = paste0("no data for λ = ", lambda_lab),
                     size = 4) +
            xlab("X1") + ylab("X2") +
            labs(
              title    = paste0("λ = ", lambda_lab),
              subtitle = "ARI: NA"
            ) +
            theme_minimal() +
            theme(legend.position = "none")
        )
      }

      # there should be exactly one row per chr × coverage
      mat <- row_cv$muS[[1]]   # N × K
      mat <- as.matrix(mat)

      panel_title <- paste0("λ = ", lambda_lab)

      # all-zero (or constant) → t-SNE / ARI not meaningful
      if (all(mat == 0) || sd(as.vector(mat)) == 0) {
        return(
          ggplot() +
            geom_rect(aes(xmin = -10, xmax = 10,
                          ymin = -10, ymax = 10),
                      fill = NA, color = "grey70", linewidth = 0.6) +
            annotate("text",
                     x = 0, y = 0,
                     label = "(all counts identical;\n t-SNE / ARI not computed)",
                     size = 4) +
            xlab("X1") + ylab("X2") +
            labs(
              title    = panel_title,
              subtitle = "ARI: NA"
            ) +
            theme_minimal() +
            theme(legend.position = "none")
        )
      }

      # t-SNE on cells (columns)
      tsne_res <- Rtsne(t(mat),
                        initial_dims = npc,
                        perplexity   = pplx,
                        theta        = 0,
                        pca_center   = FALSE)

      # k-means in 2D t-SNE space
      km_res <- kmeans(tsne_res$Y,
                       centers = 3,
                       nstart  = n_rep)

      ari_val <- adjustedRandIndex(
        rep(1:3, each = n_rep),
        km_res$cluster
      )

      emb_df <- data.frame(
        X1      = tsne_res$Y[, 1],
        X2      = tsne_res$Y[, 2],
        Cluster = factor(km_res$cluster),
        Type    = cell_type_label  # length 30
      )

      ggplot(emb_df, aes(x = X1, y = X2,
                         color = Type, shape = Cluster)) +
        geom_point(size = 3) +
        labs(
          title    = panel_title,
          subtitle = paste("ARI:", round(ari_val, 3))
        ) +
        theme_minimal() +
        theme(legend.position = "none")
    })

    # 5 x 2 grid (10 coverages) for this chromosome
    do.call(
      grid.arrange,
      c(tsne_plots,
        ncol = 5,
        top  = paste0("Chromosome ", chr_id,
                      " — clustering of downsampled counts Y across λ"))
    )
  }
}

## Example call:
## (assuming list_y_sim is your tibble and cell_type_label is defined)
plot_tsne_simY_by_chr_tbl(list_y_sim,
                          npc = 20,
                          pplx = 7,
                          n_rep = 10,
                          tsne_seed = 12345)

```


```{r, fig.width=12}
plot_umap_simY_by_chr_tbl <- function(list_y_sim,
                                      n_neighbors = 10,
                                      n_rep       = 10,
                                      umap_seed   = 12345) {
  # unique chromosomes (numeric)
  chr_ids <- sort(unique(list_y_sim$chr))

  # coverage levels in desired order (from the ordered factor if present)
  cov_levels <- levels(list_y_sim$coverage)
  if (is.null(cov_levels)) {
    cov_levels <- sort(unique(list_y_sim$coverage))
  }

  for (chr_id in chr_ids) {
    chr_dat <- list_y_sim %>%
      filter(chr == chr_id)

    if (nrow(chr_dat) == 0) {
      warning("No rows for chr = ", chr_id)
      next
    }

    set.seed(umap_seed)

    umap_plots <- lapply(cov_levels, function(cv) {
      # subset row for this chr and coverage
      row_cv <- chr_dat %>% filter(coverage == cv)

      lambda_lab <- as.character(cv)

      # if missing this coverage, show placeholder
      if (nrow(row_cv) == 0) {
        return(
          ggplot() +
            geom_rect(aes(xmin = -10, xmax = 10,
                          ymin = -10, ymax = 10),
                      fill = NA, color = "grey70", linewidth = 0.6) +
            annotate("text",
                     x = 0, y = 0,
                     label = paste0("no data for λ = ", lambda_lab),
                     size = 4) +
            xlab("X1") + ylab("X2") +
            labs(
              title    = paste0("λ = ", lambda_lab),
              subtitle = "ARI: NA"
            ) +
            theme_minimal() +
            theme(legend.position = "none")
        )
      }

      # there should be exactly one row per chr × coverage
      mat <- row_cv$muS[[1]]   # N × K
      mat <- as.matrix(mat)

      panel_title <- paste0("λ = ", lambda_lab)

      # all-zero (or constant) → UMAP / ARI not meaningful
      if (all(mat == 0) || sd(as.vector(mat)) == 0) {
        return(
          ggplot() +
            geom_rect(aes(xmin = -10, xmax = 10,
                          ymin = -10, ymax = 10),
                      fill = NA, color = "grey70", linewidth = 0.6) +
            annotate("text",
                     x = 0, y = 0,
                     label = "(all counts identical;\n UMAP / ARI not computed)",
                     size = 4) +
            xlab("X1") + ylab("X2") +
            labs(
              title    = panel_title,
              subtitle = "ARI: NA"
            ) +
            theme_minimal() +
            theme(legend.position = "none")
        )
      }

      # UMAP on cells (columns)
      umap_cfg <- umap.defaults
      umap_cfg$n_neighbors  <- n_neighbors
      umap_cfg$random_state <- umap_seed

      umap_res <- umap(t(mat), config = umap_cfg)
      emb      <- umap_res$layout  # K × 2 matrix

      # k-means in 2D UMAP space
      km_res <- kmeans(emb,
                       centers = 3,
                       nstart  = n_rep)

      ari_val <- adjustedRandIndex(
        rep(1:3, each = n_rep),
        km_res$cluster
      )

      emb_df <- data.frame(
        X1      = emb[, 1],
        X2      = emb[, 2],
        Cluster = factor(km_res$cluster),
        Type    = cell_type_label   # length 30
      )

      ggplot(emb_df, aes(x = X1, y = X2,
                         color = Type, shape = Cluster)) +
        geom_point(size = 3) +
        labs(
          title    = panel_title,
          subtitle = paste("ARI:", round(ari_val, 3))
        ) +
        theme_minimal() +
        theme(legend.position = "none")
    })

    # 5 x 2 grid (10 coverages) for this chromosome
    do.call(
      grid.arrange,
      c(umap_plots,
        ncol = 5,
        top  = paste0("Chromosome ", chr_id,
                      " — UMAP clustering of downsampled counts Y across λ"))
    )
  }
}

## Example call:
## (assuming list_y_sim is your tibble and cell_type_label is defined)
plot_umap_simY_by_chr_tbl(list_y_sim,
                          n_neighbors = 10,
                          n_rep       = 10,
                          umap_seed   = 12345)
```


```{r}
N = 4950
K = 30

## 1. Coverage levels (make sure we match muS_unified)
cov_levels <- levels(muS_unified$coverage)
lambda_vals <- as.numeric(as.character(cov_levels))

## 2. Chromosomes (take from list_muS names, ensure numeric + sorted)
chr_vec <- names(list_muS) %>% as.integer() %>% sort()

## 3. Design grid: all chr × coverage combinations
design_sim <- tidyr::crossing(
  chr      = chr_vec,
  coverage = factor(lambda_vals, levels = lambda_vals, ordered = TRUE)
)

## 4. Build tibble with same structure as muS_unified
sim_unified <- design_sim %>%
  mutate(
    model = "Simulated (Raw)",
    muS = purrr::pmap(
      list(chr, coverage),
      function(chr, coverage) {
        true_muS <- list_muS[[as.character(chr)]]
        N <- nrow(true_muS)
        K <- ncol(true_muS)
        lam <- as.numeric(as.character(coverage))

        ## mimic your original simulation
        set.seed(123456)
        mat <- matrix(
          rpois(N * K, lambda = lam * as.numeric(true_muS)),
          nrow = N, ncol = K
        )
        # keep the same cell labels
        colnames(mat) <- colnames(true_muS)
        mat
      }
    ),
    N = map_int(chr, ~ nrow(list_muS[[as.character(.x)]])),
    K = map_int(chr, ~ ncol(list_muS[[as.character(.x)]]))
  ) %>%
  select(model, chr, coverage, muS, N, K)

## 5. Combine with existing results if you want
all_models_unified <- bind_rows(sim_unified, muS_unified)

str(sim_unified)
# should look like muS_unified: tibble [500 × 6] with list-column muS
```

# Clustering using chr1

## Rstne

```{r, fig.width=12}
library(Rtsne)
library(mclust)      # for adjustedRandIndex
library(gridExtra)

## optional: ensure consistent model order
model_levels <- c("Simulated (Raw)",
                  "HiCBZIP-GB(NB)",
                  "HiCBZIP-N(GS)",
                  "HiCBZIP-N(M)",
                  "HiCImpute",
                  "scHiCluster")

## function: make 2x3 t-SNE grid for each coverage on chr1
plot_tsne_chr1_by_coverage <- function(all_models_unified,
                                       chr_id = 1,
                                       npc = 20,
                                       pplx = 7,
                                       n_rep = 10) {
# chr_id=1;npc=20;pplx=7;n_rep=10;
  # subset to this chromosome
  chr_dat <- all_models_unified %>%
    filter(chr == chr_id)

  # make sure coverage is ordered in the way you want
  cov_levels <- levels(chr_dat$coverage)
  if (is.null(cov_levels)) {
    cov_levels <- sort(unique(chr_dat$coverage))
  }

  for (covg in cov_levels) {
    # covg = 0.1
    # message("Coverage = ", covg)

    dat_cov <- chr_dat %>%
      filter(coverage == covg) %>%
      mutate(model = factor(model,
                            levels = model_levels[model_levels %in% model])) %>%
      arrange(model)

    # list of matrices, named by model (including "Downsampled")
    list_muS_cov <- setNames(dat_cov$muS, as.character(dat_cov$model))

    set.seed(123456)
    tsne_plots <- lapply(seq_along(list_muS_cov), function(i) {
  mat <- list_muS_cov[[i]]        # N x K, rows = pairs, cols = cells
  model_name <- names(list_muS_cov)[i]

  # 1) Handle all-zero (or constant) imputation: t-SNE + ARI not meaningful
  if (all(mat == 0) || sd(as.vector(mat)) == 0) {
    ari_val <- NA_real_

    # Simple placeholder panel explaining what happened
    p <- ggplot() +
    geom_rect(aes(xmin = -100, xmax = 100, ymin = -100, ymax = 100),
              fill = NA, color = "grey70", linewidth = 0.6) +
    annotate("text",
             x = 0, y = 0,
             label = paste0("(all imputed values = 0;\n",
                            "t-SNE / ARI not computed)"),
             size = 4) +
    xlab("X1") + ylab("X2") +
    labs(
      title    = model_name,
      subtitle = paste("ARI:NA")
    ) +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(legend.position = "none")


    return(p)
  }

  # 2) Normal case: run t-SNE + k-means + ARI
  tsne_res <- Rtsne(t(mat),
                    initial_dims = npc,
                    perplexity   = pplx,
                    theta        = 0,
                    pca_center   = FALSE)

  km_res <- kmeans(tsne_res$Y,
                   centers = 3,
                   nstart  = n_rep)

  ari_val <- adjustedRandIndex(rep(1:3, each = n_rep),
                               km_res$cluster)

  emb_df <- data.frame(
    X1      = tsne_res$Y[, 1],
    X2      = tsne_res$Y[, 2],
    Cluster = factor(km_res$cluster),
    Type    = cell_type_label   # length 30
  )

  ggplot(emb_df, aes(x = X1, y = X2,
                     color = Type, shape = Cluster)) +
    geom_point(size = 3) +
    labs(
      title    = model_name,
      subtitle = paste("ARI:", round(ari_val, 3))
    ) +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(legend.position = "none")
})
    # 2 x 3 grid for this coverage
    do.call(
      grid.arrange,
      c(tsne_plots,
        ncol = 3,
        top  = paste0("chr", chr_id, ", coverage λ = ", covg))
    )
  }
}

## Example call (after you created all_models_unified = bind_rows(muS_unified, sim_unified)):
plot_tsne_chr1_by_coverage(all_models_unified, chr_id = 1, npc = 20, pplx = 7, n_rep = n_rep)
```


## UMAP

```{r, fig.width=12}
library(umap)
library(mclust)

plot_umap_chr1_by_coverage <- function(all_models_unified,
                                       chr_id = 1,
                                       n_neighbors = 10,
                                       n_rep = 10) {

  # subset to chosen chromosome
  chr_dat <- all_models_unified %>%
    dplyr::filter(chr == chr_id)

  # coverage levels in desired order
  cov_levels <- levels(chr_dat$coverage)
  if (is.null(cov_levels)) {
    cov_levels <- sort(unique(chr_dat$coverage))
  }

  for (covg in cov_levels) {
    dat_cov <- chr_dat %>%
      dplyr::filter(coverage == covg) %>%
      dplyr::mutate(
        model = factor(model,
                       levels = model_levels[model_levels %in% model])
      ) %>%
      dplyr::arrange(model)

    # list of matrices for this coverage
    list_muS_cov <- setNames(dat_cov$muS, as.character(dat_cov$model))

    set.seed(123456)
    umap_plots <- lapply(seq_along(list_muS_cov), function(i) {
      mat <- list_muS_cov[[i]]        # N x K
      model_name <- names(list_muS_cov)[i]

      # 1) all-zero or constant case → placeholder panel
      if (all(mat == 0) || stats::sd(as.vector(mat)) == 0) {
        ggplot() +
          geom_rect(aes(xmin = -10, xmax = 10, ymin = -10, ymax = 10),
                    fill = NA, color = "grey70", linewidth = 0.6) +
          annotate("text",
                   x = 0, y = 0,
                   label = "(all imputed values = 0;\nUMAP / ARI not computed)",
                   size = 4) +
          xlab("X1") + ylab("X2") +
          labs(
            title    = model_name,
            subtitle = "ARI: NA"
          ) +
          theme_minimal() +
          theme(legend.position = "none")
      } else {
        # 2) normal case: run UMAP + k-means + ARI
        umap_cfg <- umap.defaults
        umap_cfg$n_neighbors   <- n_neighbors
        umap_cfg$random_state  <- 123456

        umap_res <- umap(t(mat), config = umap_cfg)
        emb <- as.data.frame(umap_res$layout)
        colnames(emb) <- c("X1", "X2")

        km_res <- kmeans(emb, centers = 3, nstart = n_rep)

        ari_val <- adjustedRandIndex(
          km_res$cluster,
          rep(1:3, each = n_rep)
        )

        emb_df <- data.frame(
          X1      = emb$X1,
          X2      = emb$X2,
          Cluster = factor(km_res$cluster),
          Type    = cell_type_label   # length 30
        )

        ggplot(emb_df, aes(x = X1, y = X2,
                           color = Type, shape = Cluster)) +
          geom_point(size = 3) +
          labs(
            title    = model_name,
            subtitle = paste("ARI:", round(ari_val, 3))
          ) +
          theme_minimal() +
          theme(legend.position = "none")
      }
    })

    # 2 x 3 grid for this coverage
    do.call(
      grid.arrange,
      c(umap_plots,
        ncol = 3,
        top  = paste0("chr", chr_id, ", coverage λ = ", covg, " (UMAP)"))
    )
  }
}

# Example call
plot_umap_chr1_by_coverage(all_models_unified,
                           chr_id = 1,
                           n_neighbors = n_rep,
                           n_rep = n_rep)

```

# Clustering using all chr

```{r}
# all_models_unified: model, chr, coverage, muS (N x K matrix), N, K

allchr_unified <- all_models_unified %>%
  arrange(coverage, model, chr) %>%              # ensure consistent chr order
  group_by(model, coverage) %>%
  summarise(
    muS = list(do.call(rbind, muS)),            # stack loci across all chromosomes
    N   = sum(N),                               # total number of pairs
    K   = first(K),                             # number of cells (should be 30)
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(chr = "all") %>%                       # optional: dummy chr label
  relocate(chr, .after = coverage)

str(allchr_unified)
# tibble [ (#models * #coverages) x 6 ]:
#   model, coverage, chr = "all", muS (N_total x K), N, K

```

```{r, fig.width=10}
plot_tsne_allchr_by_coverage <- function(allchr_unified,
                                         npc = 20,
                                         pplx = 7,
                                         n_rep = 10) {

  # make sure coverage is ordered
  cov_levels <- levels(allchr_unified$coverage)
  if (is.null(cov_levels)) {
    cov_levels <- sort(unique(allchr_unified$coverage))
  }

  for (covg in cov_levels) {
    dat_cov <- allchr_unified %>%
      filter(coverage == covg) %>%
      mutate(
        model = factor(model,
                       levels = model_levels[model_levels %in% model])
      ) %>%
      arrange(model)

    # list of combined matrices (all chromosomes) for this coverage
    list_muS_cov <- setNames(dat_cov$muS, as.character(dat_cov$model))

    set.seed(123456)
    tsne_plots <- lapply(seq_along(list_muS_cov), function(i) {
      mat <- list_muS_cov[[i]]          # N_total x K
      model_name <- names(list_muS_cov)[i]

      # all-zero / constant → placeholder
      if (all(mat == 0) || sd(as.vector(mat)) == 0) {
        ggplot() +
          geom_rect(aes(xmin = -100, xmax = 100,
                        ymin = -100, ymax = 100),
                    fill = NA, color = "grey70", linewidth = 0.6) +
          annotate("text",
                   x = 0, y = 0,
                   label = "(all imputed values = 0;\n t-SNE / ARI not computed)",
                   size = 4) +
          xlab("X1") + ylab("X2") +
          labs(
            title    = model_name,
            subtitle = "ARI: NA"
          ) +
          theme_minimal() +
          theme(legend.position = "none")
      } else {
        # normal case: t-SNE + k-means + ARI
        tsne_res <- Rtsne(t(mat),
                          initial_dims = npc,
                          perplexity   = pplx,
                          theta        = 0,
                          pca_center   = FALSE)

        km_res <- kmeans(tsne_res$Y,
                         centers = 3,
                         nstart  = n_rep)

        ari_val <- adjustedRandIndex(
          rep(1:3, each = n_rep),
          km_res$cluster
        )

        emb_df <- data.frame(
          X1      = tsne_res$Y[,1],
          X2      = tsne_res$Y[,2],
          Cluster = factor(km_res$cluster),
          Type    = cell_type_label  # length 30
        )

        ggplot(emb_df, aes(x = X1, y = X2,
                           color = Type, shape = Cluster)) +
          geom_point(size = 3) +
          labs(
            title    = model_name,
            subtitle = paste("ARI:", round(ari_val, 3))
          ) +
          theme_minimal() +
          theme(legend.position = "none")
      }
    })

    # 2 x 3 grid for this coverage
    do.call(
      grid.arrange,
      c(tsne_plots,
        ncol = 3,
        top  = paste0("All chromosomes combined, coverage λ = ", covg))
    )
  }
}

plot_tsne_allchr_by_coverage(allchr_unified, npc = 20, pplx = 8, n_rep = n_rep)
```

```{r, fig.width=10}
plot_umap_allchr_by_coverage <- function(allchr_unified,
                                       n_neighbors = 10,
                                       n_rep = 10) {

  # subset to chosen chromosome
  chr_dat <- allchr_unified

  # coverage levels in desired order
  cov_levels <- levels(chr_dat$coverage)
  if (is.null(cov_levels)) {
    cov_levels <- sort(unique(chr_dat$coverage))
  }

  for (covg in cov_levels) {
    dat_cov <- chr_dat %>%
      dplyr::filter(coverage == covg) %>%
      dplyr::mutate(
        model = factor(model,
                       levels = model_levels[model_levels %in% model])
      ) %>%
      dplyr::arrange(model)

    # list of matrices for this coverage
    list_muS_cov <- setNames(dat_cov$muS, as.character(dat_cov$model))

    set.seed(12345)
    umap_plots <- lapply(seq_along(list_muS_cov), function(i) {
      mat <- list_muS_cov[[i]]        # N x K
      model_name <- names(list_muS_cov)[i]

      # 1) all-zero or constant case → placeholder panel
      if (all(mat == 0) || stats::sd(as.vector(mat)) == 0) {
        ggplot() +
          geom_rect(aes(xmin = -10, xmax = 10, ymin = -10, ymax = 10),
                    fill = NA, color = "grey70", linewidth = 0.6) +
          annotate("text",
                   x = 0, y = 0,
                   label = "(all imputed values = 0;\nUMAP / ARI not computed)",
                   size = 4) +
          xlab("X1") + ylab("X2") +
          labs(
            title    = model_name,
            subtitle = "ARI: NA"
          ) +
          theme_minimal() +
          theme(legend.position = "none")
      } else {
        # 2) normal case: run UMAP + k-means + ARI
        umap_cfg <- umap.defaults
        umap_cfg$n_neighbors   <- n_neighbors
        umap_cfg$random_state  <- 123456

        umap_res <- umap(t(mat), config = umap_cfg)
        emb <- as.data.frame(umap_res$layout)
        colnames(emb) <- c("X1", "X2")

        km_res <- kmeans(emb, centers = 3, nstart = n_rep)

        ari_val <- adjustedRandIndex(
          km_res$cluster,
          rep(1:3, each = n_rep)
        )

        emb_df <- data.frame(
          X1      = emb$X1,
          X2      = emb$X2,
          Cluster = factor(km_res$cluster),
          Type    = cell_type_label   # length 30
        )

        ggplot(emb_df, aes(x = X1, y = X2,
                           color = Type, shape = Cluster)) +
          geom_point(size = 3) +
          labs(
            title    = model_name,
            subtitle = paste("ARI:", round(ari_val, 3))
          ) +
          theme_minimal() +
          theme(legend.position = "none")
      }
    })

    # 2 x 3 grid for this coverage
    do.call(
      grid.arrange,
      c(umap_plots,
        ncol = 3,
        top  = paste0("chr", chr_id, ", coverage λ = ", covg, " (UMAP)"))
    )
  }
}

# Example call
plot_umap_allchr_by_coverage(allchr_unified,
                           n_neighbors = n_rep,
                           n_rep = n_rep)
```
